review_notes.evidence: KU311 banks/bank7 context3.png; KU311 bank7 bottom.png
review_notes.finding: The physical diagram prints U03AF 3350G1 at E-B3B7, grid 7M. The A1 socket listing also indexes 3350E1 at this socket, but no second B7 box appears in the native lower bank.

review_notes.evidence: KU311 banks/bank1 clean2.png; KU311 banks/bank2 clean1.png; KU311 banks/bank3 clean1.png
review_notes.finding: The native boxes AF, AK and AR print 0410J1, 3388F1 and 0410H1 respectively, unlike the A1 index. Physical printed values retained.

review_notes.evidence: KU311 banks/bank6 context3.png; KU311 wires center lower.png
review_notes.finding: The native box prints UC3AF rather than U03AF. The printed C is retained as a source revision or typographic difference.

review_notes.location: KU311 AN.D09 and BH.D12, row-55 input-only rail
review_notes.evidence: KU311 AN lower rail.png; KU311 BGdetail.png
review_notes.finding: The scan shows AN.D09 and BH.D12 joined by the long row-55 rail. Its visible leftward continuation has no identifiable printed driver on this sheet. Three crossings at the AN vertical have no diamond and remain unjoined.

review_notes.location: KU311 upper console latch rails, rows 2 and 26
review_notes.evidence: KU311 upper right trace.png; KU311 top right rails.png
review_notes.finding: Row 2 rises from the BD B10 / BK D09 diamond before the inverter. Row 26 branches from BK D07 after the inverter. The BP B13 and BQ B04 diamonds are on the latter rail.
The native output terminal reads D10 with no adjacent star; an earlier draft D11✲ was corrected.

review_notes.location: KU311 parallel BA and BR trigger rails, bank 5/7 middle
review_notes.finding: BA D02 is the upper rail to BS B09 and -FLT BACKSPACE TGR. BR D10 descends to the lower parallel rail and branches at a printed diamond to BF D05 and BG D05. Their crossings are unjoined.

review_notes.location: KU311 BE B02 and B03 input-stub crossings
review_notes.finding: The -MACH RESET vertical crosses both input stubs as unjoined plus crossings. BE B02 is driven by +CHECK RESET PB and B03 by -FLT COMPLETE.

review_notes.location: KU311 three middle source rails, rows 51-53
review_notes.evidence: KU311 middle three source rails1.png; KU311 sync junction exact.png; KU311 BF inputs and FLT exact.png; KU311 sync line whole.png
review_notes.finding: +ROS TEST+FLT LTH reaches BF B07 and BG B10 through the diamonded middle vertical. +SYNC TRIGGER rises to BQ D06. -FLT COMPLETE bends upward into BE B03 and crosses the neighboring BF B07 conductor without joining.
